FX-RADIAL-001.says: Spin 30 about the middle: every edge smears round the centre, the further out the longer, and the middle of the block stays solid.

FX-RADIAL-002.says: Zoom 30 about the middle: every edge smears both ways along the line from the centre, inward and outward alike, the further out the longer.

FX-RADIAL-004.says: Spin 30 about the top left corner, centre 0, 0: the smears are arcs about that corner, so the far corner smears most.

FX-RADIAL-005.says: Zoom 30 about centre 25, 50, the point (4, 5): everything smears along the line from it, the block, right of it, onto column 10, and the line, left of it, onto column 1 and off the drawing, so columns 2 and 3 stay empty.

FX-RADIAL-006.says: Spin 100, the most: longer arcs than FX-RADIAL-001.

FX-RADIAL-007.says: Zoom 100, the most: each pixel samples a quarter of its distance from the centre either side of itself.

FX-RADIAL-008.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, spin, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 spins 20, frame 4 spins 40.

FX-RADIAL-009.says: Centre keyed from 50, 50 at frame 0 to 0, 0 at frame 4, spin 30: frame 0 is FX-RADIAL-001, frame 2 turns about 25, 25, frame 4 is FX-RADIAL-004.

FX-RADIAL-010.says: Spin 30, moved three pixels right: the centre moves with the drawing, and nothing is drawn left of the drawing's edge.

FX-RADIAL-011.says: Spin 100 about centre -1000, -1000, far off the top left: every pixel's arc is longer than 255 pixels, so each takes the most samples, 256.

FX-RADIAL-012.says: A directional blur, direction 90 and length 4, then spin 30 about centre 0, 0: the directional blur grew the layer two pixels on every side, and the spin still turns about the drawing's own top left corner.

FX-RADIAL-013.says: Amount 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RADIAL-014.says: Amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RADIAL-015.says: Amount keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RADIAL-016.says: Centre 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RADIAL-017.says: Type "twist", which is not a type. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RADIAL-018.says: Type "Spin": the word is exact, so a capital is not the type. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
